title: Hinomori Shiho — Hugs Of Friendship♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Have you all had a chance to exchange your cards?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we're all done.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My heart's full of so much joy after receiving all these thoughtful cards.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mine too. Not only were they fun to make, I got to tell you all things that I couldn't normally.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right.
Thank you for hosting this wonderful event for us, you two!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really glad you guys enjoyed everything♪
Now I can't wait to give Tsukasa and my parents their cards!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You made some for your family.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you gonna give Shizuku her card later?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I was gonna, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you've changed your mind?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, Shih, you have to give it to her!
I mean, you worked so hard on it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's for sure gonna blow it way out of proportion, and I'm sort of getting self-conscious about the whole thing.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now I wish I hadn't put her off until last...
A few hours later
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Can I come in, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hi, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, please come in.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that you decided to come over, Shii! How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Umm... This is for you. I wanted to thank you for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, what a wonderful card...!
The stickers of these little birds are so adorable! And these leaves around the border are beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, Shii, did you make this yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... You embroidered that handkerchief for me for Valentine's Day, so I thought I should also make you something in return.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I mean, you're always doing things for me, so I figure doing stuff like this isn't so bad, from time to time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you so much, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...! Sh-Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to receive such a lovely card. I'm so happy right now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: O-Okay, I get it...! Let go of me already.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
But I promise to cherish this card forever!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's really nothing that special...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But you made this card just for me. That means it's a true one-of-a-kind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, can I read what you wrote?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
“Dear Shizuku.
Thank you for always keeping me in your thoughts. I know that you lead a really busy life.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wait, she's gonna read the whole thing out loud...?!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I really admire how you treat your fans with the utmost respect, and I think it's cool how much you do to exceed their expectations.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Shii, you really believe...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can we please get this over with already?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “But please don't forget to take breaks from time to time, for the sake of your own health. I'll always be rooting for you as you strive to become a great idol.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I honestly wasn't expecting her to read my message out loud right in front of me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If I'd known she'd do that, I would have just read it out myself.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shii.
My heart's full of so much joy now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The card is lovely by itself, and then you also wrote me such a sweet message...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I honestly couldn't have asked for a better gift.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. I'm glad that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Telling anyone how I actually feel is still pretty embarrassing for me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if she's feeling this happy...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then maybe I should do this more in the future.)
